summary.intent: Diagnose and fix failing CI checks on the open PRs #463 and #464 in the callisto repo.
summary.outcome: Found #463 fully green; on #464 identified a clippy/rustdoc failure caused by a doc link to a private constant, removed the link in release_preview.rs, verified with a local rustdoc check, and committed and pushed to feat/release-pr-headlines. The Entire Gates failure was not yet investigated or confirmed fixed.

repo: CI runs rustdoc with warnings denied, so intra-doc links to private items fail the clippy/doc job.
Local reproduction of the doc check: RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace.
PR work happens in git worktrees under .claude/worktrees (e.g. macos-15-runners), with feature branches like feat/release-pr-headlines.
The repo uses the `entire` CLI (trail show, trail finding) alongside CI; an 'Entire Gates' check exists on PRs.

code.finding: A rustdoc comment linked to a private constant, triggering a private-intra-doc-links error under -D warnings; the link was removed.

workflow: Use `gh pr checks <PR> | grep -v pass` to list only non-passing checks quickly.
Use `gh run view <run> --job <job> --log-failed | grep -E "error|warning|-->|help"` to extract concise failure details.
Reproduce CI failures locally with the same flags before pushing a fix.
Commits in this setup use `-c commit.gpgsign=false` and full git path /usr/bin/git.
